title: Human rights in Estonia - Wikipedia
body: Human rights in Estonia are acknowledged as being generally respected by the government. Estonia has been classified as a full democracy, with moderate privacy and human development in Europe.

title: Estonia: Freedom on the Net 2023 Country Report | Freedom House
body: Reporters Without Borders’ 2023 Press Freedom Index ranks Estonia as the eighth freest country out of 180 measured. Press freedom is guaranteed in both legal and political spheres.

title: Estonia ranks third in 2026 World Press Freedom Index
body: In Europe, RSF says press freedom remains stronger than in other regions, but legal protections are weakening. Estonia remains one of the best-performing countries, though the report notes that its public broadcaster has not been immune to pressure.
